name: Trento-Bondone Hillclimb (Uphill)
description: The classic Italian hillclimb, run since 1925 from the edge of Trento up the flank of Monte Bondone: 17.3 kilometres and better than 1,300 metres of climb through more than thirty hairpins. It became a round of the European Hill Climb Championship in 1957. Summer, uphill, one run.
